Engaging in therapy could provide you with a safe space to explore these feelings further. A mental health professional can help you develop coping strategies to manage guilt and work through any underlying emotions.

In the meantime, grounding techniques may help ease your mind. Try focusing on your breath, taking a few moments to inhale deeply and exhale slowly, or engage in a calming activity like journaling or going for a walk. These practices can help center you and provide some relief from overwhelming emotions.

Remember, healing takes time, and it's okay to seek help along the way. You're not alone in this process.
